correctness.rationale: The pair recursion preserves gcd 1 over every field. For prime p|t, A_prime(2m+1) is congruent to A_m(X^t), coprime to A_2m+1; hence odd-index discriminants are p-units and nonzero. Composition with X^{t^r} preserves zero simplicity in characteristic 0 and the exact discriminant magnitude has t^{r deg} factor. The 113-polynomial exact symbolic check covers 124 prime-power valuations and 74 modular separability comparisons, without being treated as infinite proof.
